title: Month-End Expiry of Owner Rewards Points — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Scope.** For the month-end expiry of an open retail rewards account, this policy sets the points expiring, and only for such an expiry; any other expiry still removes the points earned in calendar months whose expiry period, the tier's expiry period in months after the month earned, has ended at the end of that calendar month, oldest points used first. A retail rewards account is a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account at a Kessler Owner Rewards tier.

**Effect of an expiry.** The points expiring at a month-end run leave the account's rewards points balance through a points-expired entry; the account holder sees the lower points balance.

## Tool: `expire_owner_points_a6cb3dc9`
**Capability.** Posts the month-end expiry of Owner Rewards points on a service account: one points-expired entry for the stated month, dated today, lowering the account's rewards points balance by the points expired.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `expire_owner_points_a6cb3dc9` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | Reference number of the holder's service account, as returned by the service account lookup | Id |
| `billing_month` | The calendar month of the month-end run | YYYY-MM (four-digit year, hyphen, two-digit month) |
| `points` | Number of points expired | Whole number (integer, no decimals, no separators), greater than zero |

**Return.** A one-line receipt beginning with the word Expired, naming the expiry reference, the month, the points expired and the account's resulting points balance. A string beginning with Error is returned, and nothing is booked, when `points` is not a whole number greater than zero or when `billing_month` is not written YYYY-MM.
